cards.text: Zechariah, a prophet, is bringing God's people a message from the LORD (Zechariah 1:1). This part of it starts with something every farmer cares about. Rain in springtime.

cards.question: The message tells the people to ask someone for rain in springtime. Who?

cards.text: The LORD makes the storm clouds, and He'll give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field. But then the message turns to idols and diviners.

cards.question: True or false: The message says idols and diviners give the people real comfort.

cards.text: Idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions, telling false dreams and offering empty comfort. That's the dead batteries I shared a junk drawer with, swearing every single day they still had a little charge left, and friend, they did NOT.

cards.question: Because of this, the people wander like sheep, oppressed for lack of a ___.

cards.text: Now the LORD Himself speaks, and He's talking about the shepherds and the leaders. Oh, friend, the whole room just got quiet.

cards.question: The LORD says His anger burns against the shepherds. What does He say He'll do to the leaders?

cards.text: The LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah, the people who came from Jacob's son Judah (Genesis 29:35). And He's got big plans for these sheep.

cards.question: The LORD says He'll make His flock, the house of Judah, like what?

cards.text: A flock of SHEEP, made like a ROYAL STEED? That's clocking out as the intern and clocking back in running the whole company! Then the LORD names a cornerstone, a tent peg, a battle bow and every ruler together.

cards.question: The LORD says the cornerstone will come from ___.
True or false: The LORD says the people of Judah will fight because the LORD is with them.

cards.text: They'll be like mighty men in battle, trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets. And they'll put the horsemen to shame.
The LORD keeps going, and now He widens the circle. He'll strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph, the people who came from Jacob's son Joseph (Genesis 30:24).

cards.question: The LORD says He'll restore Judah and Joseph. What reason does He give?

cards.text: And they'll be as though He had not rejected them. Friend, after YEARS in the back of a junk drawer, getting pulled out like it never happened would have me crying into the dough.

cards.question: True or false: The LORD promises He will answer Judah and Joseph.

cards.text: Next up, Ephraim, the people who came from Joseph's son Ephraim (Genesis 41:52). They'll be like a mighty man, their hearts glad as with wine, and they won't be the only ones glad about it.

cards.question: Ephraim's hearts will be glad. Who else will see it and be joyful, rejoicing in the LORD?

cards.text: Then the LORD says He'll whistle for them to gather. One whistle, when the rest of us need seventeen reminder texts in the group chat just to get everybody in the same room!

cards.question: The LORD says why He'll whistle for His people to gather. What does He say?

cards.text: They'll be as numerous as they once were. Then the LORD talks about sowing them among the nations.

cards.question: Though the LORD sows them among the nations, His people will ___ Him in distant lands.

cards.text: They and their children will live and return. The LORD will bring them back from Egypt, gather them from Assyria, and bring them to Gilead and Lebanon.

cards.question: The LORD will bring His people to Gilead and Lebanon until no more ___ is found for them.

cards.text: No more ROOM, like my cooling rack on a big baking day begging me, "Papa, PLEASE!" Then the LORD says they'll pass through the sea of distress and strike the waves, and all the depths of the Nile will dry up.

cards.question: Egypt and Assyria come up again. What does the LORD say happens to them?

answers.text: Assyria's pride falls and Egypt's scepter departs
Assyria's king repents and Egypt's king bows
Assyria's army joins them and Egypt's gates open

cards.question: True or false: The LORD ends by saying His people will walk in their own strength.

cards.text: That's how the LORD closes it out. He will strengthen them in the LORD, and in His name they will walk.
